dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple interconnected, irregular light-colored rings forming a reticulated lattice across the dorsal-lateral surface. Each structure shows a sharp pixel-intensity increase at the boundary, defining the perimeter, with the interior pixels returning to the lower-intensity base tone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of isolated, high-intensity pixel clusters distributed mainly along the ventral-lateral margin, appearing as solid, non-gradient points against the darker background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-mid macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, while a group of four high-intensity blobs in the anterior-lateral region forms a localized quadrilateral cluster.
